# Exposure profile (`exposure-profile` v1)

Simulated EE, EPE, ENE and PFE by time bucket for a netting set.

**Group:** Exposure and capital · **Mnemonic:** `EXP` · **Identifiers:** `EXP-…` in `profileId`

Open one with `EXP <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: exposure-profile
version: 1
description: "Simulated EE, EPE, ENE and PFE by time bucket for a netting set."
match: { kind: exposure-profile, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Exposure and capital · Exposure profile, id: $.profileId }
strip:
  - { label: EPE, bind: $.epe, fmt: compact }
  - { label: EEPE, bind: $.eepe, fmt: compact }
  - { label: PFE 95 peak, bind: $.pfePeak, fmt: compact, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Paths, bind: $.paths, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Run, bind: $.runDate, fmt: date }
panels:
  - id: profile
    kind: area
    title: Exposure (USD)
    key: F2
    rows: $.buckets
    x: tenor
    series:
      - { label: EE, value: ee, tone: link }
      - { label: PFE 95, value: pfe95, tone: accent }
      - { label: ENE, value: ene, tone: neg }
  - id: buckets
    kind: table
    title: Buckets
    rows: $.buckets
    columns:
      - { label: Tenor, bind: "@.tenor" }
      - { label: EE, bind: "@.ee", fmt: compact }
      - { label: ENE, bind: "@.ene", fmt: compact }
      - { label: PFE 95, bind: "@.pfe95", fmt: compact }
      - { label: PFE 99, bind: "@.pfe99", fmt: compact }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.nettingSet, 'netting-set')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
